supersedes: All v1 and r2 evidence is historical. The final approved source and runtime images are r3.
scope: Viewer-right front leg death only: three rotation curves, hip/thigh junction and attached hem, lower calf taper and ankle/foot connection. Other limbs/body, living motion and asset geometry remain unchanged.
normalPolicy: Rotate each original custom normal by only its original-to-new geometric-normal rotation, preserving authored custom-normal deviation.
limitation: Offline Blender source-texture renders use actual prepared CPU skin. They are not live game shader, mobile FPS or GPU measurements. Independent SDK preparation audit is separate.
